selected_mechanisms.root_cause: transferFrom calls _transfer(sender,recipient,amount) BEFORE checking currentAllowance>=amount. Balances mutate before the allowance guard. In a pure ERC20 with no hooks, Solidity 0.8 atomicity reverts on LowAllowance, so practical impact is limited to correctness/auditability; but the ordering violates ERC20 implied semantics and becomes a real allowance-bypass if _transfer is ever overridden with a hook.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Caller with 0 allowance calls transferFrom(victim,attacker,X); _transfer runs, then allowance check reverts. No hooks: atomic revert. With future hook: allowance bypass.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. 0 allowance. 2. transferFrom(victim,attacker,X). 3. _transfer mutates balances. 4. allowance 0<X -> revert. 5. atomic revert (no net harm now); with hook in _transfer, bypass.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Currently none (atomic revert); with hooks, victim loses tokens without approval.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Documented ERC20 ordering violation (check-after-effect); latent vuln if subclassed; pattern awarded in prior ZRC20 audits.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: burn() is fully permissionless; any holder burns their own ZRC20 (representing locked external-chain assets) WITHOUT going through withdraw() (which emits Withdrawal -> CCTX). Tokens destroyed on ZetaChain with no external-chain release -> permanent supply discrepancy and fund loss.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Any holder calls burn() (user error / misuse). Primary victim is the caller themselves.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. user holds ZRC20 (e.g. locked BTC). 2. user calls burn(amount). 3. _burn: balance/totalSupply decrement, Transfer(user,0). 4. no Withdrawal, no CCTX, no external release. 5. tokens destroyed, external assets permanently locked.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Holder who calls burn() loses ZRC20 + corresponding external-chain assets (permanent).
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Cross-chain supply invariant violation; permissionless; permanent fund loss; no source-level guard. Clears Medium, potentially High.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: withdraw() calls IZRC20(gasZRC20).transferFrom subject to the transferFrom ordering flaw; compounds with _burn if gasZRC20==address(this)
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: withdraw transferFrom(msg.sender, FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS, gasFee) then _burn; if gasZRC20==this, ordering+burn interact.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether gasZRC20 can equal address(this) in practice and whether reentrancy exists if gasZRC20 is a hook-bearing contract.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Withdrawing user could lose gas fee without completing withdrawal in edge cases.
